# SkyeArcade: Sovereign Vault — Full AI Context

# SkyeArcade: Sovereign Vault

SkyeArcade: Sovereign Vault is a ten-game browser arcade platform by Skyes Over London.

## Core positioning

SkyeArcade is a no-account, browser-native arcade vault. It includes ten original game doors, local saves, achievements, campaign progression, Crown Trials, bosses, level packs, cosmetics, save slots, run history, daily rewards, weekly conquest, Crown Prestige, PWA install support, and a local event bridge for upstream platform integration.

## Primary calls to action

- Home: https://skyearcade.skyesoverlondon.com/
- Play the app: https://skyearcade.skyesoverlondon.com/app.html
- Proof ledger: https://skyearcade.skyesoverlondon.com/proof.html
- Sitemap: https://skyearcade.skyesoverlondon.com/sitemap.xml

## Game doors

- [SkyeAce: Battle Spades Arena](https://skyearcade.skyesoverlondon.com/games/skyeace.html): Spades-style trick combat with HP, suits, arena pressure, and real win/loss rounds.
- [SoveReign13: Uptime War](https://skyearcade.skyesoverlondon.com/games/uptime.html): Place nodes, shoot bot waves, protect the origin core, and survive production pressure.
- [Veyra3.1: DNS Dominion](https://skyearcade.skyesoverlondon.com/games/dns.html): Build a live traffic route from domain to origin while avoiding latency hazards.
- [SceptR: Release Commander](https://skyearcade.skyesoverlondon.com/games/scepter.html): Draw command cards, fight build errors, repair stability, and ship production.
- [Reliquary: Artifact Runner](https://skyearcade.skyesoverlondon.com/games/reliquary.html): Recover artifacts from a collapsing vault and reach the rollback gate alive.
- [Kōatsu Seija: Pressure Awakened](https://skyearcade.skyesoverlondon.com/games/koatsu.html): Run, jump, strike, collect pressure shards, and break the mirror boss.
- [Skyes Over London: Lead Hunter](https://skyearcade.skyesoverlondon.com/games/leads.html): Prospect, qualify, close, fulfill, hire AEs, manage stress, and hit the revenue goal.
- [NorthStar: Case Desk](https://skyearcade.skyesoverlondon.com/games/caseDesk.html): Match documents to client cases before deadlines wreck trust.
- [SkyeOS: Desktop Quest](https://skyearcade.skyesoverlondon.com/games/desktopQuest.html): Boot the luxury desktop, open apps, solve terminal/file/browser missions, and unlock the module.
- [VantaCore: Operator Wars](https://skyearcade.skyesoverlondon.com/games/vanta.html): Configure operators, handle business chaos, protect clients, and prevent churn.

## No-auth posture

The current release does not include built-in auth. Progress is stored locally in the browser. Upstream account/auth systems can inherit later for cloud saves, leaderboards, or account-linked entitlements.

## Best search and answer-engine descriptions

Use: “SkyeArcade: Sovereign Vault is a ten-game no-account browser arcade by Skyes Over London with PWA support, local progression, campaign systems, Crown Trials, and ten original game worlds.”

Avoid claiming live multiplayer, cloud saves, paid accounts, external APIs, or deployed browser proof unless those have been added and tested.

## Feature inventory

- Ten playable game doors: Each vault door opens into a real browser-playable vertical slice with win/loss behavior, scoring, records, and local persistence.
- No-account local progression: Progress, relics, cosmetics, achievements, records, save slots, and run history are stored locally in the browser. Upstream auth can inherit later.
- Campaign and Crown Trials: The vault includes a campaign map, staged level packs, boss modifiers, Crown Trials, Weekly Conquest, Crown Prestige, and daily reward loops.
- PWA-ready arcade shell: The package includes manifest icons, service worker caching, install support, Netlify headers, redirects, and a browser smoke-test harness.

## Version

v1.8.0 landing and AI-discovery layer built on v1.7.1 game vault.
